statement: (n d : ℕ) (hd : d ∈ properUnitaryDivisors n) : d ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : d ∈ Finset.Ico 1 n ∧ d ∣ n ∧ d.Coprime (n / d) := by
    -- Extract the conditions from the membership in properUnitaryDivisors
    have h₁ : d ∈ properUnitaryDivisors n := hd
    have h₂ : d ∈ {d ∈ Finset.Ico 1 n | d ∣ n ∧ d.Coprime (n / d)} := by
      simpa [properUnitaryDivisors] using h₁
    -- Simplify the membership condition
    have h₃ : d ∈ Finset.Ico 1 n ∧ d ∣ n ∧ d.Coprime (n / d) := by
      simpa using h₂
    exact h₃
  
  have h₂ : d ∣ n := by
    -- Extract the divisibility condition from h₁
    have h₃ : d ∣ n := h₁.2.1
    exact h₃
  
  exact h₂
